coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies (estates) at will of any building. No unit-count, building-age or owner-occupancy limits are stated.
coverage.other_conditions: Tenancies (estates) at will only; tenancies under a written lease are governed by § 11.

evidence.quoted_span: Estates at will may be determined by either party by three months' notice in writing for that purpose given to the other party
In case of neglect or refusal to pay the rent due from a tenant at will, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the tenancy
Upon the neglect or refusal to pay the rent due under a written lease, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the lease

result.notes: Coverage was essentially correct. Section 12 contains no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits. Its scope is the tenancy type (estate at will), which an address lookup cannot determine. However, it applies across ordinary rental housing rather than to a special building class, so it is not a requires_unknown_facts rule. That field is left null rather than asserted false, because no passage addresses it. The rule is a termination-notice rule, not a just-cause limit.
